units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得周围景象果然凄凉可怕，推想这是因为向来常和许多人聚居一室之故，这一变倒也有趣。

en.t: Prince Genji felt that the scene around him was indeed desolate and frightening, and guessed that it seemed so because he was used to living in one room with many people; this change, however, was also rather interesting.

units.source_text: 车子驱进院内，停在西厢前，解下牛来，把车辕搁在栏杆上。

en.t: The carriage was driven into the grounds and stopped before the western wing; the ox was unyoked, and the shafts were rested on the railing.

units.source_text: 源氏公子等人就坐在车中等候打扫房间。

en.t: Prince Genji and the others remained seated in the carriage, waiting while the rooms were cleaned.

units.source_text: 侍女右近看看这光景，不胜惊异，心中偷偷地想起女主人以前和头中将私通时的情状。

en.t: The maid Ukon looked at this scene and was deeply astonished, secretly recalling in her heart how things had been when her mistress once had an affair with To no Chujo.

units.source_text: 守院人东奔西走，殷勤服侍。

en.t: The caretaker of the estate hurried about in every direction, serving them attentively.

units.source_text: 右近已看出源氏公子的身份了。

en.t: Ukon had already discerned Prince Genji's identity.
